resources-carousel.looks: A sliding row of related resources or articles: up to six pinned pages first, then the rest filled from the resource library based on the page it sits on, with a 'find all' button.
resources-carousel.use: Only on resource and article pages, when asked.

fields.heading: Pre-filled 'Related Resources'.
fields.programs: Optional program filter, e.g. kidsmartz or netsmartz.
fields.pinned1: Optional page to show first: a resource page when sourceType is resources, a blog page when it is articles. The rest fill automatically.
